tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything (app shell, login). Never put cards directly on bg without a border in dark.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: inputs, code blocks, timeline tracks, the office stage behind the illustration.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default card, panel, sidebar, top bar and table surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: One step up from surface: table headers, nested tiles inside a card, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating layers: modals, drawers, menus, toasts. In light it relies on shadow-3 for separation.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover plate for rows, nav items, ghost buttons and interactive cards.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row / active nav item / chosen segmented option (indigo-tinted).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers: card edges, table row separators, section rules. Decorative; not for controls.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Standard border for buttons, chips and raised tiles where the edge is structural.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border on interactive cards and rows; dashed trace connectors.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of form controls (input, select, checkbox, switch track). Meets 3:1 against surface and bg-sunken.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body text, titles, values. Default foreground.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: descriptions, table cells, message bodies.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Metadata: timestamps, eyebrows, captions, placeholders. Still AA (4.5:1) on every surface — the smallest text uses it.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels only (exempt from contrast). Never for readable content.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on a light fill in dark mode (and vice versa), e.g. a tooltip that inverts.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and danger fills (primary/danger buttons, selected badges).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signature electric indigo. Fills: primary button, active tab underline, switch on, progress, the office accent lights.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills. Darker, so text-on-accent stays AA.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed/active state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text/icon: links, active nav label and icon, "ouvrir →" affordances. AA on all surfaces.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Indigo tint background: selected states, accent chip, Timmy's own message marker.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Border of accent-subtle elements (selected card, selected segmented option).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline on every interactive element (offset 2px). 3:1+ against bg and surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal/drawer backdrop colour; applied at 64% (dark) / 40% (light) opacity by the component.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive outcome: run succeeded, gateway connected, skill active. Solid: dots, icons, text on surface.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted background for success chips, banners and toasts. Pair with success text.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Border for success banners and toasts (decorative, with text carrying meaning).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention but not broken: missing binary, stale data, unavailable skill. Solid: dots, icons, text on surface.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted background for warning chips, banners and toasts. Pair with warning text.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Border for warning banners and toasts (decorative, with text carrying meaning).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failure or destructive: run failed, gateway down, Supprimer. Also the fill of danger buttons (dark uses danger-fill). Solid: dots, icons, text on surface.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted background for danger chips, banners and toasts. Pair with danger text.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border for danger banners and toasts (decorative, with text carrying meaning).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: hints, scheduled/cron provenance, informative toasts. Solid: dots, icons, text on surface.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Tinted background for info chips, banners and toasts. Pair with info text.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: Border for info banners and toasts (decorative, with text carrying meaning).

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of danger buttons and the armed state of a two-step confirm; white text stays AA.

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: Inactif — available, nothing running. Office pose: idle. Dot, ring, glow, chip text and icon. Never alone: always with the state icon and label.

tokens.name: state-idle-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the idle agent-state badge and roster highlight.

tokens.name: state-thinking
tokens.usage: Réfléchit — model is planning/reasoning. Office pose: thinking. Dot, ring, glow, chip text and icon. Never alone: always with the state icon and label.

tokens.name: state-thinking-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the thinking agent-state badge and roster highlight.

tokens.name: state-working
tokens.usage: Exécute — active run at the desk. Office pose: working at desk. Dot, ring, glow, chip text and icon. Never alone: always with the state icon and label.

tokens.name: state-working-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the working agent-state badge and roster highlight.

tokens.name: state-researching
tokens.usage: Recherche — web search/fetch/read. Office pose: working at desk + reading accessory. Dot, ring, glow, chip text and icon. Never alone: always with the state icon and label.

tokens.name: state-researching-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the researching agent-state badge and roster highlight.

tokens.name: state-writing
tokens.usage: Rédige — composing a reply or a document. Office pose: working at desk (typing). Dot, ring, glow, chip text and icon. Never alone: always with the state icon and label.

tokens.name: state-writing-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the writing agent-state badge and roster highlight.

tokens.name: state-calling
tokens.usage: Appel d'outil — executing a tool. Office pose: talking (call accessory). Dot, ring, glow, chip text and icon. Never alone: always with the state icon and label.

tokens.name: state-calling-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the calling agent-state badge and roster highlight.

tokens.name: state-waiting
tokens.usage: En attente — blocked on a human or approval. Office pose: idle + waiting marker. Dot, ring, glow, chip text and icon. Never alone: always with the state icon and label.

tokens.name: state-waiting-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the waiting agent-state badge and roster highlight.

tokens.name: state-error
tokens.usage: Erreur — last run failed. Office pose: error/alert. Dot, ring, glow, chip text and icon. Never alone: always with the state icon and label.

tokens.name: state-error-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the error agent-state badge and roster highlight.

tokens.name: state-offline
tokens.usage: Hors ligne — gateway unreachable or agent asleep. Office pose: sleeping. Graphic only (3:1); chip text uses text-tertiary. Dot, ring, glow, chip text and icon. Never alone: always with the state icon and label.

tokens.name: state-offline-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the offline agent-state badge and roster highlight.

tokens.name: label-slate
tokens.usage: Project label colour "slate" (Projets flags/labels): chip text and dot. Categorical only; never a status.

tokens.name: label-slate-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a "slate" label chip.

tokens.name: label-indigo
tokens.usage: Project label colour "indigo" (Projets flags/labels): chip text and dot. Categorical only; never a status.

tokens.name: label-indigo-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a "indigo" label chip.

tokens.name: label-teal
tokens.usage: Project label colour "teal" (Projets flags/labels): chip text and dot. Categorical only; never a status.

tokens.name: label-teal-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a "teal" label chip.

tokens.name: label-amber
tokens.usage: Project label colour "amber" (Projets flags/labels): chip text and dot. Categorical only; never a status.

tokens.name: label-amber-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a "amber" label chip.

tokens.name: label-rose
tokens.usage: Project label colour "rose" (Projets flags/labels): chip text and dot. Categorical only; never a status.

tokens.name: label-rose-bg

tokens.usage: Tint behind a "green" label chip.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap. Resets.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets: gap between stacked nav items, icon nudges. The only off-grid step.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tightest gap: icon ↔ text inside chips, label ↔ value in tiles.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default inline gap: button icon, chip groups, list row inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card grid gap; field ↔ field in compact forms; row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; mobile page gutter; section gap inside a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Modal padding; gap between a header and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large section separation; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Login panel padding; hero spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Login split gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Largest gap: empty-state illustration margin, cover page.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small controls (segmented, compact buttons, search in toolbars).

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons (login submit, mobile primary actions).

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on mobile; icon buttons grow to this under 820px.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width.

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Desktop and mobile top bar height (excluding safe-area inset).

tokens.name: size-bottombar
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom navigation height (excluding safe-area inset).

tokens.name: size-aside
tokens.usage: Bureau right panel (roster + tabs) and the desktop drawer width.

tokens.name: size-kanban-column
tokens.usage: Width of a Projets board column (cards stack inside). Columns scroll horizontally.

tokens.name: size-repo-thumb
tokens.usage: Height of the repo preview image in a project card (16:9 crop, full card width).

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Max width of detail pages (task, skill, log, interlocutor).

tokens.name: size-prose
tokens.usage: Max line length for descriptions, chat column and markdown.

tokens.name: breakpoint-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile layout below this width (bottom bar, stacked layouts). Same value as the current app.

tokens.name: size-ed-page
tokens.usage: Editorial pages (Bulletin, Carnet, Feuillet): maximum content width, folio + reading column + margin.

tokens.name: size-ed-folio
tokens.usage: Editorial folio column: section number or date folio left of the reading column. Hidden on narrow layouts.

tokens.name: size-ed-margin
tokens.usage: Editorial margin column: one margin note per article (secondary fact, evidence link).

tokens.name: size-ed-measure
tokens.usage: Editorial reading measure: maximum width of a lead headline or a prose paragraph.

tokens.name: size-rule-section
tokens.usage: Strong neutral rule above an editorial section (text-primary colour).

tokens.name: size-rule-masthead
tokens.usage: The masthead rule under an editorial page title (text-primary colour).

tokens.name: size-field-short
tokens.usage: Identity study semantic dimension; cap to available width.

tokens.name: size-field-medium
tokens.usage: Identity study semantic dimension; cap to available width.

tokens.name: size-field-url
tokens.usage: Identity study semantic dimension; cap to available width.

tokens.usage: Identity study semantic dimension; cap to available width.

tokens.name: size-identity-aside
tokens.usage: Identity study semantic dimension; cap to available width.

tokens.name: size-identity-row
tokens.usage: Identity study semantic dimension; cap to available width.

tokens.name: size-identity-avatar
tokens.usage: Identity study semantic dimension; cap to available width.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Square edges: table cells, full-bleed media.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, kbd, small count badges, timeline bars.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls, icon tiles under 40px.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, list containers, code blocks, chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, the office stage, login panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, agent-state badges, live pill, avatars, switch tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Flat: default for cards in dark mode (elevation comes from surface steps + borders).

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and tiles in light mode. Practically invisible in dark, by design.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Hovered interactive cards, dropdowns, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, toasts — the only shadow strong enough to read on dark.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Normal flow.

tokens.name: z-raised
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers, office labels above the canvas.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky page headers and filter asides.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sidebar, top bar and mobile bottom bar.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawers and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts: above modals so mutation feedback is always visible.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips: topmost.
